purpose: Teach: アングル/ブラザー/キャリー/ストリング/ブックス/アンバランス/ワンポイント/ダート

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、写真部でカメラのアングル研究してたな
lines.en: Riku, I remember you were always researching camera angles in the photo club.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Soft opening. Playful accusatory tone without malice. A knowing smile in the voice. She's enjoying catching him out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ブラザーのプリンター使ってたよな、桜
lines.en: Sakura, weren't you the one using the Brother printer all the time?
lines.style: Quick deflection, almost a laugh underneath. Caught and turning it around. Not defensive—more a gentle counterattack. Warm, self-aware.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「キャリー」の映画は怖くて観られなかったろ
lines.en: Riku, you couldn't even watch Carrie because it scared you too much.
lines.style: Dry, almost sing-song delivery on the tease. Eyebrow up in the voice. She knows this one hits. Not cruel—just the delighted accuracy of someone who remembers everything.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、軽音部でストリング、つまり弦の張替え覚えたな、桜
lines.en: Sakura, you learned how to change guitar strings in the light music club, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. A small grin in the tone. Equally armed with his own remembered details. Speaking like he's been keeping score, but kindly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ブックス、つまり書店でバイトしてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were working part-time at the bookstore for ages.
lines.style: Casual, conversational. Slight tilt of amusement. Not pressing hard—just stating fact with a little spark of knowing. Like she's turning pages in a shared book.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サッカー部の練習メニューがアンバランスだって言ってたろ、桜
lines.en: You said the soccer team's practice schedule was completely unbalanced, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. He's checking his memory against hers, speaking with the confidence of someone who was listening. Not accusatory—gentle, almost vulnerable in its precision.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、制服のワンポイント刺繍気にしてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were so self-conscious about that little embroidered detail on your uniform.
lines.style: Amused, drawn-out delivery on the image. Wry fondness underneath. The tease of someone who noticed the small anxieties no one else sees. Voice carries a knowing warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ダート競技、つまり競馬のダートに詳しかったな、桜
lines.en: Sakura, you knew way too much about horse racing and dirt tracks.
lines.style: Surprised admission, almost laughing at the oddness of it. Close, conspiratorial. Like he's delighted by how specific she is. Warm and a little in awe of her depth.
